tool.name: Eggsplorer
tool.description: interactive HTML report of eggNOG-mapper functional annotations
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/eggsplorer.py' --input '$annotations' #if str($sample_name).strip(): --name '$sample_name' #else: --name '$annotations.element_identifier' #end if --output '$report' #if $kofam_cond.use_kofam == 'yes': --kofam '$kofam_cond.kofam' --mode '$kofam_cond.mode' #end if #if str($filters.max_evalue): --max-evalue $filters.max_evalue #end if #if str($filters.min_score): --min-score $filters.min_score #end if --top-n $top_n --lang '$lang' --plotly inline #if $output_tables: --tables tables #end if

param.name: sample_name
param.label: Sample name
param.help: Shown as the report title. Leave empty to use the dataset name.

param.name: use_kofam
param.label: Add KofamScan KO assignments as a second source?
param.help: KofamScan assigns KOs with profile HMMs and adaptive thresholds, independently of eggNOG orthology.

param.name: kofam
param.label: KofamScan output
param.help: detail-tsv (hits above threshold are marked with *) or mapper format. Gene IDs must match the eggNOG input.

param.name: mode
param.label: How to combine eggNOG and KofamScan
param.option: Union: gene–KO pairs from either tool
Consensus: only pairs both tools agree on

param.name: max_evalue
param.label: Maximum e-value of the seed ortholog
param.help: Leave empty to keep all hits. Example: 1e-10.

param.name: min_score
param.label: Minimum bit score of the seed ortholog
param.help: Leave empty to keep all hits.

param.name: output_tables
param.label: Also output summary tables
param.help: COG counts, top GO terms, KEGG pathways and modules, EC, TC transporter families, CAZy families and substrates, Pfam and metabolic function scores as tabular datasets.

tool.help:
**What it does**
**Eggsplorer** turns the annotations table of **eggNOG-mapper** into one self-contained, interactive HTML report. The report needs no internet connection: the plotting library is embedded and no database is queried.
Sections:
- **Overview**: number of proteins, share with a functional annotation, coverage of every eggNOG-mapper column. - **Level of annotation transfer**: ``max_annot_lvl`` and the narrowest orthologous group, which show from which taxonomic level annotations were transferred. - **COG functional categories** as a radar chart with a table, grouped into the four COG super-categories. - **Most frequent GO terms**: top 20 per ontology (biological process, molecular function, cellular component), after mapping to current GO terms, propagating to parents and hiding very general or redundant terms. This is a frequency profile, not an enrichment test. GO data (CC BY 4.0) is bundled with the tool. - **Cell overview**: the components found in the genome drawn where they act in the cell (respiratory chain, uptake systems, secretion and export, the largest transporter families, motility, metabolic function groups) on a fixed template; the envelope is diderm when BamA is found with lipid A synthesis (LpxA, LpxC, LpxD) or LptD, and a cell wall is drawn only with peptidoglycan synthesis. NDH-1 counts both the nuo and the cyanobacterial ndh complex; b6f, the Rnf complex, SusCD (Bacteroidetes) and ESX (type VII secretion, Actinobacteria) are drawn when present. A component is drawn when its completeness is at least 0.50 and not all of its genes belong to a better-scoring component (one gene can carry several KOs); the others are listed under the drawing. Tiles for alternative systems (phototrophy, carbon fixation and C1, hydrogenases) name the systems found; methanogenesis is drawn only with methyl-coenzyme M reductase. - **Metabolic function completeness**: the functions with at least one step present, scored with the definitions of Graham et al. (2018) from a bundled, unmodified copy of its scoring code. Scores are corrected for known issues of the original definitions (alcohol dehydrogenases never counted in mixed-acid fermentation, functions without defined KOs, scores capped at 0.99, Sec-SRP counted only when SecDF is present, fused nuoCD not counted). Clicking a function lists the supporting genes, copy numbers, found KOs and the missing steps that would raise the score. - **Element cycles**: nitrogen, sulfur, carbon fixation, C1 and hydrogen steps as diagrams with fixed layout, each arrow coloured by the completeness of its genes. The sulfur diagram separates dissimilatory sulfate reduction (outer arrows) from assimilation (inner arrows: sat or cysDN, cysH, cysJI or sir; KEGG module M00176) and sends TsdA/DoxDA to tetrathionate and Sox to sulfate. DNRA needs NrfA; NirBD/NirA and NasA/NarB alone are drawn as assimilation. A step without its catalytic subunit is drawn pale; the CBB cycle needs RuBisCO and phosphoribulokinase, the serine pathway malyl-CoA lyase, the RuMP pathway Hps and Phi, and methanogenesis methyl-coenzyme M reductase. Steps that rest on the same proteins (also across diagrams, such as ammonia and methane monooxygenase) are drawn dashed and listed under the diagrams. - **Transporters**: Sankey diagram from TC class to subclass and family, and a table of families with names. - **Enzymes**: Sankey diagram from EC class to subclass and sub-subclass with ENZYME names (bundled, CC BY 4.0), the most frequent enzymes, and CAZy classes and families with their main activity and a link to the CAZy family page. - **Carbohydrate-active enzymes by substrate**: degradative CAZy families grouped by the glycans they act on (substrates per family from dbCAN-sub, Zheng et al. 2023), separating families whose main activity is that substrate from families that can also act on it. - **Pfam domains** and the most frequent domain combinations. - **Genes**: searchable table of all proteins.
-----
**Inputs**
- *eggNOG-mapper annotations* (``*.emapper.annotations``). - Optional *KofamScan* output (``-f detail-tsv`` or ``-f mapper``) as a second, HMM-based source of KO assignments. Gene identifiers must match those of the eggNOG-mapper input.
**Outputs**
- HTML report. - Optional collection of tabular summary tables.
-----
**Notes**
- No KEGG data is bundled: KEGG appears only as KO identifiers that link to the KEGG website. Genes per KEGG pathway and module (identifiers only) are available in the optional tables. - KO assignments by eggNOG-mapper are inferred through orthology. Use the quality filters or KofamScan (consensus mode) for higher confidence. - **For Galaxy administrators**: Galaxy sanitises HTML outputs by default, which removes the report's JavaScript. Add this tool to ``sanitize_allowlist_file`` so the report works inside Galaxy. Users can always download the report and open it in a browser.
**Citation**
Eggsplorer: paper submitted.
If you use the metabolic function scores, please cite KEGG-Decoder (Graham, Heidelberg and Tully 2018, ISME J 12:1861–1866) together with eggNOG-mapper and KEGG.
